title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Several Specific Issues concerning the Trial of Cases Where a Party Applies for Setting Aside an Arbitral Award

articles.content_en: 1. For cases that were accepted before the implementation of the Arbitration Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Arbitration Law) by arbitration institutions established in accordance with relevant regulations prior to the implementation of the Arbitration Law and heard after the implementation of the Arbitration Law, the relevant provisions of the Arbitration Law shall, in principle, apply. Given that the system of the original arbitration institutions differs from that of arbitration institutions as stipulated in the Arbitration Law, where the original arbitration institutions encounter difficulties in applying certain provisions of the Arbitration Law, such as the composition of the arbitral tribunal, the relevant provisions of the Regulations of the People's Republic of China for the Arbitration of Economic Contracts may also apply. The People's Court, when hearing a case concerning an application for setting aside an arbitral award, shall not set aside the arbitral award on the grounds that the provisions of the Arbitration Law have not been applied.
2. Where one party applies to the People's Court for setting aside an arbitral award, the People's Court shall, when hearing the case, list the other party as the respondent.

3. For a case where a party applies to the People's Court for setting aside an arbitral award, the case acceptance fee shall be charged in accordance with the fee standard for non-property cases; such fee shall be paid by the applicant.
This is hereby replied.
